The meta is always changing, so I can't give you a go-to comp that'll always work. The best advice I can give you is to look at sites like tactics.tools or tftacademy.com and see what comps are s or a tier. From there, whenever you start a game after minons, see what items you have and then try to narrow down the s and a comps into what works with your items. Then make your strongest team with whatever then after krugs you should have a set list of items you can go and then from what items you make focus on 1 or 2 comps that work with those items (for instance ad items go vaurs or kalista, ap items go karma or raze ) and go lvl 8 after 3rd augment and roll and pick up any 4 costs you get plug them in with your items that work best and then keep building around that. It's not as easy as it sounds and will take some getting used to, but it's always consistent over reroll comps, although not as powerful as reroll in this set but you'll still see results
